Hi Elena — thanks for the clear spec and timeline. I copied Marissa (Customer Ops) and Connor (Infra) to coordinate the execution.

High-level purge workflow (summary):
1) Scoping confirmation — we will remove: prompt inputs, model outputs, KV cache entries, derivative embeddings, and ephemeral execution traces tied to tenant MED-12. We will not delete billing records or core tenant record IDs needed for long-term billing reconciliation unless you explicitly instruct otherwise.
2) Pre-run snapshot & dry run — Infra will take a snapshot and run a non-destructive dry-run to enumerate objects targeted for deletion.
3) Final purge execution — KV sweep and object delete across blob stores and the ephemeral LRU caches; model-level artifacts will be overwritten in the cache layer and purged from persistent stores.
4) Evidence package — a final_manifest.json (file list + SHA256 checksums), an audit log excerpt (time-windowed), and a signed manifest PDF.
5) Delivery — we will push the evidence package to your secure S3 bucket (or transfer via the DocuSign/secure link you prefer).

Questions for you:
- Confirm tenant id is MED-12 and applicable timeframe (all artifacts since tenant creation, or only since 2024-01-01?)
- Do you want embeddings and derivative indices expunged? (these are stored separately and require index rebuild notice)
- Preferred evidence delivery target (S3 bucket details or upload link)?

I've attached a purge_manifest_template.pdf to show the structure of the evidence bundle. Connor/Marissa — can you propose a maintenance window and initial dry-run date?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen

Redwood Inference

Hi all — technical reply from Infra.

We can meet the 2025-10-10 deadline; proposed plan and specifics below: 

Scope:
- Prompts (raw inputs) — persistent objects in blob store: will be enumerated by tenant tag MED-12 and deleted.
- Outputs (model responses) — same as prompts; includes stream fragments stored for 24/7 observability (we will include them in scope).
- KV cache entries — two tiers: ephemeral in-memory/redis (evicted immediately as part of sweep) and persistent KV snapshots (we will zeroize corresponding keys and purge snapshots).
- Embeddings/derivatives — confirm if you want them removed; these are in a separate index (we can delete the index shards and rebuild if needed).

Execution plan:
1) Dry run (no deletes) — list generation and checksums produced: dryrun_report_stub.txt.
2) Approve by MedicSoft (reply all with GO).
3) Schedule window: 2025-10-06 23:00 UTC — 2025-10-07 01:00 UTC (low traffic).
4) Final purge — parallel deletes across regions where MED-12 has objects.
5) Proof bundle generation: final_manifest.json + signed manifest PDF; audit log excerpts will include the operations with job ids.

Residual metadata: we retain minimal ticket-level metadata (job id, timestamp) for billing reconciliation for up to 90 days; no content-level artifacts retained. If you need zero retention for metadata, we can discuss.

Delivery: we will upload the proof bundle to the S3 path you provide or make it available via a secure STS URL. We will also attach SHA256 checksums and a runbook excerpt.

Attachments: dryrun_report_stub.txt (will be replaced by actual report after dry run), final_manifest.json (template).

Connor O'Brien
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
